checks.explanation: The Federal Reserve did cut rates by 50 basis points at the September 2024 FOMC meeting.
By the end of 2024 the Fed had cut a cumulative 100 basis points (50 in September, 25 in November, 25 in December), matching the higher end of the market-implied odds described.
This prediction is simply a report of prevailing market-implied odds at the time rather than a personal forecast, and the actual outcome (a 50bp cut) was the less-favored scenario in those odds.
The 2024 election was competitive in several swing states, but Trump ultimately won all seven swing states and the national popular vote, a more decisive outcome than a razor-thin nail-biter.
As the 2024 campaign progressed, Harris faced increasing pressure over her lack of media availability and her polling advantage did erode in the final stretch before the election.
No distinct investment class of sovereign wealth funds specifically financing entrepreneurs' US exit taxes has emerged as a recognized asset category.
Cross-border capital flows have generally continued to become more fungible and flexible in the years following 2024.
No federal US wealth tax has been implemented, and California's 2026 billionaire tax measure has not yet been voted on or implemented, so this pattern cannot yet be tested.
